title: try using selenium 4.0.0a1
description: a few useful features were added to selenium 4.0.0a1 that are being used in shiny-server tests, like opening new tabs in a window without explicitly calling javascript. try using this updated version of the selenium python package. it isn't explicitly supported by selene, but it may still be compatible enough.

title: set container's id to match host user's id for services like ssh
description:
Launching a Docker container based on the rstudio/checkrs-tew:0.5.0 image, with the configured user, sets the uid and gid for the user to 1000:1000. Thisi s the default for the first user on Ubuntu and the uid and gid are embedded within the /etc/passwd and /etc/group files. If you launch the container with a uid and gid other than 1000:1000, the user is no longer recognized in the container and services like ssh complain that there is no user with your uid.

for example launching the container with:
```bash
$ docker run --rm --init -it --user=999:999 rstudio/checkrs-tew:0.5.0 bash
```

and trying to ssh shows this error: 
```bash
$ ssh some_other_host -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -l user

No user exists for uid 999
```
